questions.question: How is the king's heart described in Proverbs 21?
options: A restless and surging sea that not even the very wisest can ever calm
A sealed and hidden thing that not one of his subjects may ever truly know
An immovable and solid rock that no power on all the earth can shift aside
A stream of water in the hand of the LORD, who turns it wherever he will
questions.answer: A stream of water in the hand of the LORD, who turns it wherever he will

questions.question: What does Proverbs 21 say the LORD prefers over sacrifice?
options: To bring great gifts of gold
To offer up many words of prayer
